POSTAL PANICMAIL RUSH

Deliver the mail, dodge the dogs, beat the bosses, and save up to retire in style.

How to Play

🚚 Load packages at your truck, then run to every 🏠 mailbox and deliver.
⬆ Jump (Spring Soles in the shop unlock the double jump) and ✉️ throw junk mail at enemies.
🏁 Return to the truck to finish. Beat the ⚔ boss after level 10.
🪙 Earn coins, then spend them in the shop. Don't run out of ❤️!
🏖 Save up to retire, then cruise resorts in a golf cart: ⤒ to hop obstacles, ✉ to honk.

Move ◀ ▶ Jump ⤒ Throw ✉ Sprint 💨 Pick up / deliver 📦 Pause ⏸ Letters at once ✉️ ×3
